full_name: João Alves | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2018–2019 Physical Sciences Edward, Frances, and Shirley B. Daniels Fellow University of Vienna (Austria)
bio: João Alves is a professor of stellar astrophysics at the University of Vienna, in Austria. His primary research interest is to understand how diffuse interstellar gas clouds form, evolve, and eventually collapse to form stars and planets.
